WORK id=ising_open_32x32 kind=ising beta=0.3000000000000000 n=1024 q=2 warmup=400 draws=2000 thin=1 trials=5 seed0=260833615
SOURCE Open 32x32 Ising, J=1, beta=0.3. Past the transfer matrix. exact_energy is Onsager's infinite-lattice internal energy times N, not the finite-lattice mean. Checkerboard block Gibbs. The spin-model notebook (https://docs.thrml.ai/en/latest/02_spin_models.html) scales a Pegasus Ising model for throughput on GPUs; that graph is not an enumerable law.
